description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeePictureModel' within the OrangeHRM project, representing a model for employee picture data in the HRM system. It implements serialization and normalization features, and is associated with an entity 'EmpPicture'. The class primarily sets up filtering and attribute naming configurations for API serialization.

classes.name: EmployeePictureModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing and normalizing employee picture data in the OrangeHRM API, implementing the Normalizable interface and using traits for serialization support.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an EmpPicture entity and sets up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
